articleTitle: Should You Use Sliders for Stretching and Flexibility?
imageHeadline: Sliders let you train flexibility you can actually use
imageSubtext: Active stretching with control beats forcing a position you can't hold
pinTitle: Should You Use Sliders for Stretching and Flexibility? Evidence-Based Guide
pinDescription: Sliders reduce friction during floor stretches so you can actively move through range of motion for hamstrings, hips, and splits—building strength at end range instead of just passively sitting in a stretch. Learn how they work, what research says, and when to add them to your flexibility routine.

items.label: Warm up with light movement first
Do 2-3 sets of slider drills for target areas
Control the slide—stop before form breaks
Finish with static stretching if desired
